rv.q: Mac's tour-de-fierce performance is reason enough to plan a visit to Orlando.
In fact, there’s little enjoyment to be had overall.
With intentional casting and whimsical performances, this production will be a treat for audiences.
But the production’s push-and-pull ultimately frustrates.

cn.t: This revival of Sarah Ruhl's adaptation delights with its riotous take on Woolf's gender-fluid time-traveling tale, featuring Taylor Mac in a performance that embraces the story's playful spirit and theatrical possibilities.
